name: Kokuyo Mamoru
source:
Part of unit MAISY

A somewhat spiritual and mysterious young man who can practically read minds and see others' auras.
He is childhood friends with Kojo Arata and Kamiya Inori.
He was the unit's moral support, but something happened...
